text: One small change, found late, touches everything after it.
And it is not new. The same kind of change has happened before.
Everything needed to stop it is already in the company. It is only scattered.
It connects what engineering already knows into one knowledge graph that keeps growing.
While the engineer is still finalising the design, PREVENT speaks up.
asr: While the engineer is still finalizing the design, prevents speaks up.

text: The detail is corrected. The change never has to happen.
The same knowledge serves everyone: the engineer at the screen, managers and leadership through KPIs,
and the next project, through learnings from manufacturing.
PREVENT belongs to no single person. Engineers feed it, and it feeds them.
It only works as long as that loop keeps turning.
The first step is a pilot: learn from a thousand past changes, test on a thousand more,
and move on only when the result is good enough.
